FOR THESE REASONS, THE COURT UNANIMOUSLY

1.  Declares the complaints concerning the first applicant's allegations of ill-treatment and the lack of an effective remedy, the applicants' complaints regarding the use by the Istanbul State Security Court of their statements allegedly taken under torture in the absence of legal assistance, the lack of independence and impartiality of the State Security Court on account of the presence of the military judge and the non-communication of the written submissions of the public prosecutor at the Court of Cassation, admissible;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court found the complaints admissible after examining procedural and substantive aspects related to ill-treatment, legal assistance absence, and tribunal impartiality.

holdings.text: Declares the remainder of the application inadmissible;

anchor.surface_text: 2.  Declares the remainder of the application inadmissible;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court dismissed the remainder of the application as inadmissible after considering admissibility criteria.

holdings.text: Holds that there has been both a substantive and procedural violation of Article 3 of the Convention in respect of the first applicant;

anchor.surface_text: 3.  Holds that there has been both a substantive and procedural violation of Article 3 of the Convention in respect of the first applicant;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court found that the first applicant was subjected to torture and that the investigation into the ill-treatment was inadequate, violating Article 3 substantively and procedurally.

holdings.text: Holds that there has been a violation of Article 6 §§ 1 and 3 (c) of the Convention;

anchor.surface_text: 4.  Holds that there has been a violation of Article 6 §§ 1 and 3 (c) of the Convention;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court found that the use of statements obtained under torture or ill-treatment without legal assistance rendered the trial unfair, violating Article 6 §§ 1 and 3 (c).

holdings.text: Holds that there is no need to examine separately the applicants' other complaints under Article 6 of the Convention;

anchor.surface_text: 5.  Holds that there is no need to examine separately the applicants' other complaints under Article 6 of the Convention;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court considered that the main legal questions under Article 6 had been addressed and no separate ruling on other complaints was necessary.

holdings.text: Holds that the respondent State is to pay, within three months of the date on which the judgment becomes final in accordance with Article 44 § 2 of the Convention, the following amounts, to be converted into Turkish liras at the rate applicable on the date of settlement: (i) to Ms Gülderen Baran (San) EUR 60,000 (sixty thousand euros), plus any tax that may be chargeable, in respect of non‑pecuniary damage; (ii) to Mr Hacı Aziz Hun, EUR 4,800 (four thousand eight hundred euros) plus any tax that may be chargeable, in respect of non-pecuniary damage; that from the expiry of the above-mentioned three months until settlement simple interest shall be payable on the above amounts at a rate equal to the marginal lending rate of the European Central Bank during the default period plus three percentage points;
holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court awarded non-pecuniary damages to the applicants and specified payment terms including interest for delayed payment.

holdings.text: Dismisses the remainder of the applicants' claim for just satisfaction.

anchor.surface_text: 7.  Dismisses the remainder of the applicants' claim for just satisfaction.

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court rejected other claims for just satisfaction due to lack of supporting evidence or arguments.

outcome.relief_summary: The Court found violations of Articles 3 and 6 in respect of the applicants and awarded non-pecuniary damages: EUR 60,000 to Ms Baran and EUR 4,800 to Mr Hun. The remainder of the application was declared inadmissible or dismissed. The Court ordered payment of default interest and indicated the possibility of retrial in accordance with Article 6 if requested.
directions: Respondent State to pay specified sums within three months from final judgment date.
Simple interest payable on sums from expiry of three months until settlement.
Retrial of the applicants in accordance with Article 6 if they so request.
